{{Quote|Remember your lessons. ''Feel'' the Force surrounding you. Draw strength and courage from it. You will do well.|Tili Qua|<ref name="Legacy—War 4">[[Legacy — War 4|''Legacy — War'' 4]]</ref>}}
'''Tili Qua''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chadra-Fan/Legends|Chadra-Fan]] [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] and member of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] at the [[Hidden Temple]], following the destruction of half of the [[New Jedi Order|Jedi Order]] at the hands of the [[One Sith]] order and the [[Fel Empire]].

==Biography==
{{Quote|History disagrees, Princess. Was Roan Fel not Emperor when the Empire declared war on the Galactic Alliance? Did he not continue as Emperor during that war?|Tili Qua, to Marasiah Fel|<ref name="Legacy 25" />}}
[[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] Master Tili Qua was present at the [[Hidden Temple]] upon the arrival of [[Cade Skywalker]], where he requested the aid of the [[Jedi High Council (New Jedi Order)|Jedi High Council]] in assassinating [[Darth Krayt]]. Master Qua was also present to hear the message of [[Roan Fel]], which was delivered through a contingent of his [[Imperial Knight]]s, including his daughter [[Princess/Legends|Princess]] [[Marasiah Fel]]. Fel's Knights revealed that the [[Emperor/Legends|Emperor]] wished to form an alliance between the [[New Jedi Order]] and the [[Empire-in-exile]], with the objective of overthrowing [[Darth Krayt's Galactic Empire]]. Master Qua held some reservations about the Jedi allying themselves with the Imperial Knights after Roan Fel willingly, if reluctantly, [[Sith–Imperial War|warred]] with the Jedi and sided with the [[Sith/Legends|Sith]], an act which resulted in the devastation of the Order.<ref name="Legacy 25" />

Master Qua was present with the rest of the Jedi Council when they agreed to allow the reborn Darth Krayt's forces to [[Attack on the Hidden Temple|attack]] the Hidden Temple, in order to allow [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Gar Stazi]]'s [[Galactic Alliance Remnant|fleet]] and Fel's fleet to ambush the Sith-Imperial fleet and deal a devastating blow to the Sith Empire.<ref name="Legacy War 3">[[Legacy — War 3|''Legacy — War'' 3]]</ref> When Darth Krayt's [[Dragon ship]]s began devastating the allied fleets, Master Qua evacuated the Hidden Temple in a vessel holding the Jedi [[Youngling/Legends|younglings]], encouraging them to draw strength from [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] to combat their fear.<ref name="Legacy War 4">[[Legacy — War 4|''Legacy — War'' 4]]</ref>

After the remaining ships of the allied fleet arrived at [[Bastion/Legends|Bastion]], Master Qua went down to the surface of the planet and viewed the autopsy of [[Unidentified Sith trooper (Taivas)|one]] of Darth Krayt's new [[Darth Krayt's Sith trooper|Sith troopers]] that had been captured by Cade Skywalker. Before dying, the trooper claimed to be only one of millions serving Krayt, causing Masters Qua and K'Kruhk to agree to an [[Battle of Coruscant (Sith–Imperial War)|attack]] on [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] to try to defeat Krayt before he could assert control over the entire [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]].<ref name="Legacy War 5">[[Legacy — War 5|''Legacy — War'' 5]]</ref>

Cade Skywalker slew Darth Krayt during the battle, but Roan Fel was killed as well when he attempted to [[Omega Red|purge]] all life on the planet in an attempt to win it, and his Imperial Knights were forced to stop him. Nevertheless, Tili Qua among other Jedi attended the late Emperor's [[Funeral of Roan Fel|funeral]], while K'Kruhk was chosen to represent the Jedi as a Triumvir in the newly formed [[Galactic Federation Triumvirate]].<ref name="Legacy War 6">[[Legacy — War 6|''Legacy — War'' 6]]</ref>
